cat > rosterkit/contacts.py <<'EOF'
# owner: platform
import typing

import rosterkit.models


def contact_rows(students: typing.List[rosterkit.models.Student]) -> typing.List[str]:
    if not students:
        raise ValueError("no students to list")
    for student in students:
        if not student.email:
            raise ValueError(f"no email for student {student.display_name}")
    ordered = sorted(students, key=lambda student: student.display_name)
    name_width = max(len(student.display_name) for student in ordered)
    section_width = max(len(student.section) for student in ordered)
    return [
        f"{student.display_name:<{name_width}}  {student.section:<{section_width}}  {student.email}"
        for student in ordered
    ]
EOF
cat > tests/test_contacts.py <<'EOF'
# owner: platform
import unittest

import rosterkit.contacts
import rosterkit.models


def make(last, first, section, email):
    return rosterkit.models.Student("1", last, first, section, email)


class ContactTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_when_students_are_unsorted(self):
        rows = rosterkit.contacts.contact_rows(
            [make("Zed", "Al", "B", "z@x.org"), make("Ames", "Bo", "AA", "a@x.org")]
        )
        self.assertEqual(rows, ["Ames, Bo  AA  a@x.org", "Zed, Al   B   z@x.org"])

    def test_when_email_is_missing(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "Ames, Bo"):
            rosterkit.contacts.contact_rows([make("Ames", "Bo", "A", None)])

    def test_when_list_is_empty(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            rosterkit.contacts.contact_rows([])
EOF
python -m unittest tests.test_contacts 2>&1 | tail -5
git checkout -q -b change/contacts && git add rosterkit/contacts.py tests/test_contacts.py && git commit -qm "Add contact sheet for substitute teachers
